treatment.evidence_quote: All travelers to Central Africa and 44% (8/18) of travelers to the Indian peninsula used antimalarial chemoprophylaxis
treatment.notes: 100% (17/17) of Central Africa travelers and 44% (8/18) of Indian peninsula travelers used antimalarial chemoprophylaxis; specific agents mentioned later include mefloquine, proguanil, and atovaquone.

biomarker_name.notes: Values taken from Table 1 'Abundance of resistance genes and mobile genetic elements before and after travel'; represents fold change in resistance gene abundance per bacterial 16S rRNA after international travel.

biomarker_unit.evidence_quote: Fold change ... Abundance (resistance gene copies per bacterial 16S rRNA)
biomarker_unit.notes: Table 1 also reports absolute abundance as 'resistance gene copies per bacterial 16S rRNA' before/after travel; fold change is the ratio used for the primary comparison.
